title: Agent libOS: A Runtime Substrate for Capability-Controlled Self-Evolving LLM Agents
abstract: arXiv:2606.03895v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents can persist across tasks, acquire memory, activate Skills, synthesize tools, fork child processes, attach remote resources, and commit checkpoints as reusable images. These mechanisms expand the action surface after deployment and create authority-escalation and data-exfiltration risks when visibility is mistaken for permission.   We present Agent libOS, an agent-native library OS substrate that separates three planes. Operation admission combines process identity, Task Authority ceilings, typed Capabilities, policy or Human approval, budgets, and concrete primitives. Information-flow admission propagates labels and immutable source references, resolves Host-registered Sinks, and requires an exact one-shot Human release for conditional high-sensitivity egress. translated_title: Agent libOS：一种支持能力控制的自进化LLM智能体的运行时基础
translated_abstract: 大型语言模型（LLM）智能体可以跨任务持久化、获取记忆、激活技能、合成工具、派生子进程、附加远程资源，并将检查点提交为可复用镜像。这些机制在部署后扩展了操作面，但当可见性被误认为权限时，会带来权限提升和数据泄露风险。我们提出Agent libOS，一种智能体原生库操作系统基础，它分离了三个平面。操作准入结合了进程身份、任务权限上限、类型化能力、策略或人工审批、预算和具体原语。信息流准入传播标签和不可变源引用，解析主机注册的接收器，并要求对高敏感性出站进行精确的一次性人工释放。持久因果证据记录意图、结果、核算和因果链接，但绝不授予权限。因此，模型可见的操作面与其授权权限面解耦，使智能体能够在运行中安全进化。
tldr: 该论文提出Agent libOS，一个将操作准入、信息流准入和因果证据分离的智能体运行时基础，通过能力控制和人工审批机制，确保LLM智能体在自进化时不会产生权限提升或数据泄露风险。
en_tdlr: This paper presents Agent libOS, an agent-native runtime substrate that separates operation admission, information-flow admission, and causal evidence, ensuring LLM agents can safely self-evolve without authority escalation or data exfiltration risks through capability control and human approval mechanisms.
